title: A Couple More Midnight Thoughts
description: Added what I believe are appropriate comfort tags to a couple blocks that I think were passed over from vanilla Minecraft but I felt made sense.
body:
Added what I believe are appropriate comfort tags to a couple blocks that I think were passed over from vanilla Minecraft but I felt made sense. Judging by the list Iliiasik shared on their mod's page, it looks like the didn't banners, shulker boxes, and copper bulbs (among a few others).
I also tossed in some tags for a handful of other mods I'm using because they didn't warrant getting their own page (and I cba'd to split them out of the datapack).

### Mods covered
- base Minecraft
- Backpacked
- Earth & Water

Blocks were added to the "decoration", "furniture", "lighting", and "structure" categories.

You can crack open the zip to see where I allocated various blocks and adjust as you see fit. It's best to use these as a default.
